summary: Phase 149O.20L.7O.3N.2 (Deep Repository-Wide Capability Discovery and Consumption-Gap Audit) performed a read-only, bottom-up (not architecture-chapter-organized) repository-wide sweep of all 114 core/*.py modules and 60 commands/*.py CLI modules (416 .py files under src/pcae), triggered by a concern that the prior MATURE CAPABILITY CONSUMPTION PROGRAM EXHAUSTED conclusion might not survive a discovery method independent of known architecture chapters, with prompt writing/prompt generation named as a mandatory deep-dive. Discovery method: full caller-graph census with false-positive re-verification, exhaustive source-level (not name-only) prompt keyword sweep, RI-consumer import sweep, orphan/zero-caller module audit, README/doc choreography scan, and a documented ten-question falsification attempt. Key finding: prompt writing resolves into two functionally distinct, unrelated subsystems. (1) build_bootstrap_prompt (core/context.py, also commands/phase.py/commands/session.py) is real, deterministic, local, and already production-consumed -- it is exactly what `pcae session bootstrap --compact` prints, called from inside the production session-bootstrap code path itself (context.py:367,772; commands/session.py:671; commands/phase.py:1161). The only remaining manual step (a human copying the output into a new agent session) is a deliberate trust/authority boundary, since PCAE has no runtime execution capability (`pcae runtime inspect`: execution_unavailable) -- not a missing-generation gap. (2) A previously-undocumented-in-current-status-prose 'Phase 45F-45O' prompt-generation/adaptation/validation/governance/rendering/approval/proposal chain in core/agent.py, CLI-exposed via `pcae agent prompt-*`, is self-declared non-production by its own artifacts (readiness_status 'partially_ready' with explicit listed blockers; hardcoded candidate-45M/45N/45O synthetic data unrelated to the repository's real current 149-series phase numbering) with zero non-CLI, non-self production callers -- it fails the maturity precondition for a genuine consumption-gap candidate. No other genuine S/M consumption-gap candidate was found: one true zero-caller module (core/runtime_enforcement_safety_authorization.py) is a deliberate constants-only shared-vocabulary contract, correctly disconnected (NC); the pre-existing RI-feeds-Advisory-only boundary was reconfirmed unchanged via a fresh import sweep, not reopened, consistent with 3K's prior decision; the Remote Agent dry-run/invocation-preview subsystem is intentionally preview-only; no orphaned mature context builder, planner, or reviewer was found beyond what prior phases already catalogued (3N.1's TransitionResult.explanation finding carried forward unchanged, not reopened). Zero confirmed S/M candidates; nothing was implemented. MATURE CAPABILITY CONSUMPTION PROGRAM reconfirmed EXHAUSTED -- this time via bottom-up audit rather than architecture-chapter recall -- with an explicit scope-honesty disclosure that a literal field-by-field read of every typed result class across all 416 files was not performed within this phase's budget. Recommendation: proceed with v0.4.3 publication via 149O.20L.7O.3O.1 (requires separate explicit human authorization); do not pursue prompt-dispatch automation without a dedicated future Runtime/Provider/Trust-authority phase. v0.4.3 RC (63580893b1de4782a694ab802ff7bdebdf29b0e6) unchanged, still unpublished, no tag.
